summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing for WhatsApp Flow Editor. All 7 pytest backend tests pass (root, storage CRUD, events, AI chat with Claude Sonnet 4.5, WhatsApp relay error-handling). Frontend flow validated end-to-end: MeDialog -> dashboard -> create project (Webinar strategy) -> workspace shows 13 tabs + 6 flujos; persistence in shared MongoDB confirmed across a hard reload. A previous 'LANZAMIENTO EJEMPLO PRUEBAS 1' seed project existed and was auto-loaded, confirming MongoDB-backed window.storage shim works as intended.

minor.issue: Exceptions are re-raised as HTTP 500 with the raw error string. Consider masking provider error details and returning a structured {ok:false, error:...} body for better UX.
On httpx network-level exception returns 500. Could return {ok:false, error} consistently like success path.
'shared' query param is accepted but unused (always uses storage_shared collection). Not a bug but misleading API surface.

issues: No data-testid attributes anywhere in App.jsx (3204 lines). Adding data-testid to buttons (Nuevo proyecto, Guardar, back-arrow, tabs) would make tests far more robust. Currently relying on text/CSS selectors.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid attributes to key interactive elements in App.jsx for stable automated testing.
(Optional) Return structured error JSON instead of HTTPException 500 for /api/ai/test-chat and /api/whatsapp/send on upstream failures.
(Optional) Either honor or remove the 'shared' flag in storage endpoints to match the shim's contract.
critical_code_review_comments: App.jsx is a single 3204-line file – consider splitting into per-tab components; hurts maintainability but not functionality.
server.py @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handler.
Backend has no pagination/limits safeguards beyond events endpoint; storage_get returns a single doc so OK.
No auth layer – /api/storage/* is fully public and writable; acceptable per spec (no auth required) but worth noting for production.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the key flows tested (MeDialog, dashboard, project creation, workspace tabs+flujos, reload persistence)

test_credentials: No auth in app. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY present in /app/backend/.env (used by /api/ai/test-chat).
seed_data_creation: Created shared-storage project 'TEST_Webinar_Persist' + associated flows during UI test. Left in MongoDB as evidence of persistence; main agent can delete via POST /api/storage/delete if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 7 tests). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Note: test_ai_test_chat consumes Emergent LLM credits (one short Claude Sonnet 4.5 call per run). Frontend has NO data-testid attributes – selectors rely on visible text (Spanish) and CSS. The storage-shim.js maps window.storage to /api/storage/*; shared MongoDB means projects persist across sessions globally. MeDialog name is stored in localStorage (shared=false path), everything else in Mongo.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A – no blocking issues found. One transient false-negative during playwright was that immediately after clicking 'Crear proyecto' the workspace was not fully rendered within the wait window, so tab/flujo counts came back 0; verified separately (with an existing auto-loaded project) that all 13 tabs and 6 flujos render correctly.
